geometry.source_footprint: Retained from pre-existing FUSE massing asset; all 58 closed-ring XY vertices match OSM way 256639574 (57 unique plan vertices) within the repository's local approximate transform: mean nearest-vertex distance 0.0000154 m, maximum 0.0000301 m. geometry.basis: Axis-aligned shell extents measured from saved legacy mesh with Blender 4.5.15. For OSM EPSG:4326 vertices, comparison used the repository local transform: X=(longitude+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(latitude-40.4274)*111040.0. The local approximation is not a surveyed CRS.
geometry.placement: Retained inherited coordinates. Mapletree coordinate is an address pin, not a surveyed centroid; OSM polygon corroborates the inherited shell position and orientation.
